name: § 1, point av – 45
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: av)remain mindful of the importance of keeping democracies united in response to attempts to divide them and of the strategic interests of China and Russia; work collaboratively with like-minded countries to formulate strategies concerning China’s increasingly assertive stance on the global stage; strengthen the European pillar of defence within the transatlantic alliance while consolidating the transatlantic bond and reinforcing NATO;
